verdict.rationale: Relay's docs explicitly describe receipt capture, real-time categorization, and automatic syncing to accounting software (relay-docs-3), plus named integrations with QuickBooks Online and Xero for detailed transaction sync (relay-docs-19) and Plaid-based connections to apps like Expensify (relay-docs-20). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the accounting sync quality and no detail on reconciliation accuracy or setup friction reported by users.
